name: Pinning Bodkin
desc: Drives a heavy bodkin through boot and turf, rooting target for 3s.
flavor: A good shaft saves three mercenaries from running uphill.

name: Visor Split
desc: Threads an arrow through armor seams, ignoring 50% physical armor.
flavor: Plate only works when the wearer keeps his chin down.

name: Serrated Broadhead
desc: Barbed point inflicts 5 bleed damage per second for 5s.
flavor: Pulling it out hurts twice as much as taking it in.

name: Crippling Tendon
desc: Severs heel-sinew, slowing target movement and attack speed by 40%.
flavor: Nobody charges a shield-wall on one working ankle.

name: Raking Volley
desc: Looses a spread of ash-shafts across a 3-tile area.
flavor: Measure the wind once, then darken the whole ditch.

name: Suppressive Arc
desc: Pins a 3.5-tile zone for 4s, halting enemy casts and slowing advance.
flavor: Keep their heads below the parapet while the pikes close.

name: Heartseeker
desc: Drawn to full-bend, dealing massive piercing damage with +30% crit.
flavor: One breath held, one string loosed, one less officer.

name: Hail of Yew
desc: Rains steel-tipped shafts across 4 tiles, piercing armor and morale.
flavor: Thornwick bowyers count their wages by the wagonload.

name: Briar Snare
desc: Plants hidden iron-thorns that root and bleed the first foe to step.
flavor: Fen poachers never chase prey when wire does the holding.

name: Marsh-Adder Venom
desc: Coats quiver in bog-bile; arrows deal +6 poison/s for 8s.
flavor: Milked from vipers drowned in Redmarsh brine.

name: Reed-Smoke Screen
desc: Chokes a 3-tile patch in peat-smoke, granting allies +35% evasion.
flavor: Even crossbows miss what they cannot smell through wet peat.

name: Carrion Mark
desc: Tags a target for focus fire; all squad hits gain +20% crit chance.
flavor: Crows always circle the one limping behind the line.

name: Gale Step
desc: Breaks roots and grants +50% movement speed for 4s.
flavor: Never stand where a heavy infantryman has room to swing.

name: Spore-Pod Shot
desc: Bursts a toxic puff-sac on impact, poisoning enemies within 2.5 tiles.
flavor: Harvested with tongs from Redmarsh's rotting willows.

name: Falcon's Bearing
desc: Sharpens sightlines, granting +2 reach and +25% accuracy for 8s.
flavor: Read the surf and the crosswind, and every target stands still.

name: Thornwood Ambush
desc: Erupts tangled strangler-roots across 3.5 tiles, rooting and bleeding.
flavor: Greywood remembers every axe ever laid against its bark.

name: Splinter Writ
desc: Fires a calcified rib-shard that pierces flesh and chips 2 armor.
flavor: Every pauper's grave holds plenty of affordable ammunition.

name: Raise Indentured
desc: Calls a fallen debtor's skeleton to fight for 25s until its tally clears.
flavor: Dying mid-shift does not excuse anyone from finishing the watch.

name: Ribcage Bulwark
desc: Plates an ally in borrowed femurs, absorbing 45 physical damage for 8s.
flavor: Second-hand bone stops steel just as well as fresh iron.

name: Marrow Shrapnel
desc: Shatters a bone construct or corpse, dealing piercing AoE in 2.5 tiles.
flavor: Liquidated assets rarely leave clean flagstones behind.

name: Ossuary Cage
desc: Locks target inside interlocking ribs for 3.5s, halting movement.
flavor: Consider it temporary detention pending probate review.

name: Phalanx of Arrears
desc: Summons three armored bone-bailiffs to hold a choke point for 20s.
flavor: Defaulted oaths make the most disciplined infantry in Thornvael.

name: Exact Tithe
desc: Draws 14–20 astral damage and transfers 50% as health to the caster.
flavor: A modest installment collected directly from the debtor's pulse.

name: Compound Interest
desc: Curses foe for 8s; each hit taken adds +3 astral damage to the next.
flavor: Unpaid balances grow heavier with every heartbeat.

name: Garnish Vigor
desc: Siphons target's stamina, slowing swings 30% and restoring 12 party mana.
flavor: If they cannot pay in coin, they can pay in breath.

name: Lien of Blood
desc: Grants an ally +25% lifesteal for 8s as enemies settle their tab.
flavor: Countersigned in red ink and enforced at sword-point.

name: Foreclosure
desc: Executes targets below 25% HP for double astral damage, healing allies.
flavor: When the seal is stamped, the account closes permanently.

name: Cold Ledger
desc: Chills a 2.5-tile patch with grave-rime, slowing foes by 35% for 5s.
flavor: Nothing preserves an unsettled contract like frost.

name: Witness the Fallen
desc: Consumes a nearby corpse to restore 22 mana and 25 HP to the caster.
flavor: Properly recorded, even a stranger's death balances the books.

name: Grave-Quiet
desc: Smothers target in tomb-silence for 4s, halting all spellcasting.
flavor: Speak only when summoned; the court is in recess.

name: Toll of the Pale
desc: Rings a funeral chime in 3.5 tiles, dealing cold/astral damage and fear.
flavor: Every soldier knows the sound of his own muster-roll closing.

name: Forgive the Oath
desc: Releases bound spirits to heal allies in 3 tiles and purge all hexes.
flavor: The rarest entry in any mortuary book: paid in full.

name: Barbed Shaft
desc: Looses a jagged hunting arrow for 16-24 physical damage and 4s bleed.
flavor: Poachers notch the bodkin backwards with bog-resin.

name: Gale Pin
desc: Drives a wind-lashed arrow for 26-36 physical damage and 4s slow.
flavor: Fletched with storm-kite quills, the shaft pins boots to the mud.

name: Quicklime Cloud
desc: Ruptures a caustic ash cloud for 16-24 earth damage and 6s weaken.
flavor: Parish sextons scatter slaked lime; necromancers throw the sack.

name: Bone Splinter
desc: Shatters a cursed femur across up to 4 foes for 20-30 astral damage.
flavor: Dry marrow holds an old grudge better than iron.

name: Rite of Ash
desc: Detonates a fallen corpse in an ash-fire blast for 36-52 damage.
flavor: The Rite of Ash makes the pyre do the killing.
